given: A stock record already exists for a (sku, location) pair
when: The team member files that same (sku, location) pair again
then: A confirmation of the filed record is shown and no error page is displayed
architectural_notes: User-facing half of the R3 collision rule: the second submit returns a 2xx confirmation via the app/routes boundary, never an error page. Asserted on the rendered UI outcome, so E2E.

independence.rationale: Asserts the user-facing outcome of a refile (confirmation shown, never an error page), distinct from AC3 which asserts the persisted single-row state; a build could store exactly one row yet still surface an error page to the user.
